news.title: Two Trump-backed candidates lose, Debbie Wasserman Schultz wins in Tuesday’s House primaries
news.description: Democratic Rep. Debbie Wasserman Schultz has won her party’s nomination for re-election, NBC News projects, while two Republican House candidates backed by President Donald Trump lost their primary bids in Florida on Tuesday.
